title: After the transition an aggregation over the iterated table sees only the current row
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( ALL ( 'Product'[Product], 'Product'[Price] ), "Own price", CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'Product'[Price] ) ) )

source.quote: The row context, which contains a single row, is transformed into a filter context that contains the same row.
source.supports: with CALCULATE, SUM runs in a filter context holding the current row and returns that row's value only

derivation: The transition filters Product[Product] and Product[Price] to the current row's values. Each combination matches one product, so the sum is that product's price. Without CALCULATE every row would show 180.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
